detail_full_en: Due to the impact of the heavy rain disaster, there is a suspension of services between Imaizumi and Sakamachi stations. The operating section is running on a temporary schedule. Substitute transportation is being provided. (Published November 13, 5:00 AM) Due to maintenance work, trains between Yonezawa and Imaizumi stations will be subject to service suspension from approximately 10:25 to 15:35 each day until the 13th.
